user.title: JM800 PTZ camera
user.description: Enter the camera's address and web login.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong username or password (or the account is locked after too many failures).

init.title: Alarm push
init.description: Person detection arrives as an HTTP push from the camera. Leave the URL empty to use this Home Assistant's local IP and port automatically.

data.configure_push: Point the camera's alarm server at Home Assistant
data.push_url: Home Assistant base URL the camera can reach (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123)

ptz.name: Move PTZ
ptz.description: Pan, tilt, zoom or focus. Duration 0 keeps moving until a stop.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds to move before stopping (0 = until stop).

goto_preset.name: Go to preset
goto_preset.description: Move to a saved PTZ preset.

save_preset.name: Save preset
save_preset.description: Save the current position as a preset.

play_sound.name: Play sound
play_sound.description: Play one of the camera's built-in sounds through its speaker.

file.name: File
file.description: Path of the sound on the camera.

stop_sound.name: Stop sound
stop_sound.description: Stop the sound that is playing.

set_day_night.name: Set day/night
set_day_night.description: Force day or night image (works when Day/night mode is Manual).

set_light.name: Set light
set_light.description: Turn the camera light on or off.

raw_command.name: Raw command
raw_command.description: Send any private API command and return the response (see API.md).

body.name: Body
body.description: XML/text body; empty for get commands.
